Low carbohydrate intake lowers muscle and liver glycogen stores. It shifts energy metabolism toward fat oxidation and ketone production, with some gluconeogenesis from protein. The team note says it increases reliance on muscle glycogen during exercise, and I think that's backwards, because glycogen is depleted and fat use goes up.
